headlines.title: ConocoPhillips Signs 20-Year LNG Deal With Venture Global
headlines.summary: ConocoPhillips will buy 1 million tons of LNG a year from Venture Global for 20 years starting in 2030, as Qatar disruptions reshape supply plans.

headlines.title: Venture Global jumps on ConocoPhillips LNG supply deal
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Venture Global Inc (NYSE:VG) shares climbed 3% in after-hours trading Thursday following the announcement of a 20-year liquefied natural gas supply agreement with ConocoPhillips (NYSE:COP).

ConocoPhillips Weighs Sale of Norway Business and Teesside Asset
headlines.summary: ConocoPhillips is reviewing a potential exit from major North Sea assets after receiving an unsolicited offer.

description: ConocoPhillips explores for, produces, transports, and markets crude oil, bitumen, natural gas, liquefied natural gas (LNG), and natural gas liquids. It operates in five segments: Alaska; Lower 48; Canada; Europe, Middle East and North Africa; and Asia Pacific. The company's portfolio includes unconventional plays in North America; conventional assets in North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia; global LNG developments; oil sands assets in Canada; and an inventory of global exploration prospects. It serves in the United States, Canada, China, Equatorial Guinea, Libya, Malaysia, Norway, Singapore, the United Kingdom, and internationally. ConocoPhillips was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
